PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Experienced in Business Capability Mapping, value-stream definition, Target Operating Model (TOM) design, Customer Journey Mapping, AS-IS / TO-BE process modelling, process re-engineering and optimization. Strong payments exposure spanning EFTS, NEFT, Direct Debit, Bill Payment, individual and bulk payments, Payhub, SWIFT payments and payment reconciliation. Proven ability to work with CXOs, business stakeholders, product teams and technology teams to translate business strategy into process architectures, transformation roadmaps, requirements and implementable solutions.
